_readme: Protection parameters per ecosystem type. A type only counts towards protection when verified=true and its numbers come from a cited source. Keep in sync with docs/contracts.md and frontend/src/api.js.

mangrove.label: Mangroves
mangrove.evidence: Wave height reduced 13-66% over 100 m of mangroves (McIvor et al. 2012); we use the low end per 100 m, capped at the high end. Observed surge reduction 0-0.25 m per km; we use 0.10.

saltmarsh.label: Saltmarsh
saltmarsh.evidence: TODO (P2): field studies report large wave-energy reductions over saltmarsh. Convert a cited result to wave HEIGHT reduction per 100 m before setting verified=true.

seagrass.label: Seagrass
seagrass.evidence: TODO (P2): seagrass dampens waves mainly in shallow water and stabilises sediment. Find a cited per-100 m figure before enabling.

coastal_forest.label: Coastal forest
coastal_forest.evidence: TODO (P2): beach and littoral forest mainly slows flow and traps debris rather than reducing wave height. Decide whether it belongs in the wave model at all.

riparian.label: Riverbank vegetation
riparian.evidence: Protects against riverbank erosion and cyclone-rain flooding, not coastal waves, so it is reported as hectares and people near rivers, not in the wave model.
